.emoji-picker-react .emoji { position: relative; }.emoji-picker-react .emoji.has-skin-variation button::before { content: ""; display: block; width: 0px; height: 0px; right: -2px; bottom: 0px; position: absolute; border-left: 4px solid transparent; border-right: 4px solid transparent; border-bottom: 4px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); transform: rotate(135deg); z-index: 1; }.emoji-picker-react .emoji.has-skin-variation button:hover::before, .emoji-picker-react .emoji.has-skin-variation button:focus-visible::before { border-bottom: 4px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); }.emoji-picker-react .emoji button { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; color: inherit; border-radius: 5px; transition: background 0.1s ease 0s; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; }.emoji-picker-react .emoji button:hover, .emoji-picker-react .emoji button:focus-visible, .emoji-picker-react .emoji button:focus { background-color: currentcolor; }

.emoji-picker-react .emoji-group { clear: both; padding: 0px 15px; list-style: none; margin: 0px; display: flex; flex-flow: row wrap; justify-content: space-between; }.emoji-picker-react .emoji-group::before { content: attr(data-display-name); color: rgb(170, 170, 170); font-size: 14px; position: sticky; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); width: 100%; z-index: 1; top: 0px; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 45px; font-weight: 700; }.emoji-picker-react .emoji-group::after { content: ""; flex: 1000 1 25px; order: 99999; }

.emoji-picker-react div.skin-tones-list { padding: 0px; margin: 0px; list-style-type: none; position: absolute; top: 13px; right: 40px; }.emoji-picker-react div.skin-tones-list button { background-color: currentcolor; position: absolute; border-radius: 2px; transition: transform 0.3s ease 0s; }.emoji-picker-react div.skin-tones-list button:focus { border: 1px solid rgb(166, 166, 166); border-radius: 3px; height: 14px; width: 14px; top: -2px; left: -2px; }.emoji-picker-react div.skin-tones-list button { height: 10px; width: 10px; padding: 0px; display: block; }.emoji-picker-react div.skin-tones-list button:focus { padding: 2px; }.emoji-picker-react div.skin-tones-list button#tneutral { color: rgb(255, 210, 37); }.emoji-picker-react div.skin-tones-list button#t1f3fb { color: rgb(255, 223, 189); }.emoji-picker-react div.skin-tones-list button#t1f3fc { color: rgb(233, 193, 151); }.emoji-picker-react div.skin-tones-list button#t1f3fd { color: rgb(200, 142, 98); }.emoji-picker-react div.skin-tones-list button#t1f3fe { color: rgb(168, 102, 55); }.emoji-picker-react div.skin-tones-list button#t1f3ff { color: rgb(96, 70, 58); }

.emoji-picker-react input.emoji-search { width: calc(100% - 30px); margin-left: 15px; outline: none; box-shadow: none; padding: 10px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid rgb(239, 239, 239); border-radius: 3px; transition: border 0.1s ease 0s; }.emoji-picker-react input.emoji-search:focus { border: 1px solid rgb(214, 214, 214); }

.emoji-picker-react .variation-wrapper { position: relative; }.emoji-picker-react .variation-list { background: rgb(244, 244, 244); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(239, 239, 239); position: absolute; top: 0px; right: 0px; left: 0px; z-index: 10; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; display: flex; justify-content: space-evenly; list-style-type: none; transition: transform 0.1s ease 0s; transform: translateY(-100%); }.emoji-picker-react .variation-list.visible { transform: translateY(0px); }.emoji-picker-react .variation-list button { display: flex; }.emoji-picker-react .variation-list button { border-radius: 5px; transition: background 0.1s ease 0s; background: none; padding: 0px; }.emoji-picker-react .variation-list button:hover { background-color: rgb(219, 219, 219); }
